db:select.doc:name: Select all mock endpoints
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, method, path, status_code, content_type, response_headers_json, response_body, enabled FROM syskm.mock_endpoints ORDER BY path, method

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- vars.rows map ((r) -> { id: r.id, name: r.name, method: r.method, path: r.path, statusCode: r.status_code, contentType: r.content_type, responseHeaders: read(r.response_headers_json default '{}', 'application/json'), responseBody: r.response_body default '', enabled: r.enabled == 'Y' })

db:insert.doc:name: Insert mock endpoint
db:insert.db:sql: INSERT INTO syskm.mock_endpoints (id, name, method, path, status_code, content_type, response_headers_json, response_body, enabled) VALUES (:id, :name, :method, :path, :statusCode, :contentType, :responseHeaders, :responseBody, :enabled)
db:insert.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: vars.newId, name: payload.name default 'New mock endpoint', method: (payload.method default '*') as String, path: payload.path default '/', statusCode: payload.statusCode default 200, contentType: payload.contentType default 'application/json', responseHeaders: write(payload.responseHeaders default {}, 'application/json'), responseBody: payload.responseBody default '', enabled: if ((payload.enabled default true) == true) 'Y' else 'N' }]

db:update.doc:name: Upsert mock endpoint
db:update.db:sql: MERGE INTO syskm.mock_endpoints t USING (SELECT :id AS id, :name AS name, :method AS method, :path AS path, :statusCode AS status_code, :contentType AS content_type, :responseHeaders AS response_headers_json, :responseBody AS response_body, :enabled AS enabled FROM DUAL) s ON (t.id = s.id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.name = s.name, t.method = s.method, t.path = s.path, t.status_code = s.status_code, t.content_type = s.content_type, t.response_headers_json = s.response_headers_json, t.response_body = s.response_body, t.enabled = s.enabled WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (id, name, method, path, status_code, content_type, response_headers_json, response_body, enabled) VALUES (s.id, s.name, s.method, s.path, s.status_code, s.content_type, s.response_headers_json, s.response_body, s.enabled)
db:update.db:input-parameters: #[{ id: attributes.uriParams.id, name: payload.name default 'New mock endpoint', method: (payload.method default '*') as String, path: payload.path default '/', statusCode: payload.statusCode default 200, contentType: payload.contentType default 'application/json', responseHeaders: write(payload.responseHeaders default {}, 'application/json'), responseBody: payload.responseBody default '', enabled: if ((payload.enabled default true) == true) 'Y' else 'N' }]

db:select.doc:name: Select enabled endpoints for this method
db:select.db:sql: SELECT id, name, method, path, status_code, content_type, response_headers_json, response_body FROM syskm.mock_endpoints WHERE enabled = 'Y' AND (method = :method OR method = '*')

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { error: "No mock endpoint configured for this method/path", method: attributes.method, path: vars.mockPath }

set-variable.value: #[output application/json --- ((read(vars.matched.response_headers_json default '{}', 'application/json')) filterObject ((v, k) -> lower(k) != 'content-type')) ++ {'Content-Type': vars.matched.content_type default 'application/json'}]
set-variable.doc:name: stored headers + content-type
